io_rationale: E3 ubiquitin ligase; sets TCR activation threshold and T-cell anergy. KO lowers the costimulation requirement and boosts anti-tumor immunity — canonical positive-control enhancer in T-cell KO screens.

tractability.evidence: ChEMBL target CHEMBL4879459; >20 PDB structures; Pharos-listed. Oral CBL-B inhibitors already in the clinic (see known_drugs).

genetic_evidence.anchor_disease: multiple sclerosis, type 1 diabetes, autoimmune thyroid disease
genetic_evidence.rationale: CBLB variants/reduced function are associated with increased autoimmune risk; Cblb-/- mice develop spontaneous autoimmunity. LoF -> autoimmune RISK.
genetic_evidence.interpretation_note: risk_lof (autoimmune) = mechanistically supportive for an IO KO though 'discordant' under a strict cancer-anchored rule.
